abstract:
PURPOSE: To develop and benchmark 3D dose prediction algorithms for volumetric modulated arc therapy for head-and-neck (HN) and pancreatic cancer treatments, and to demonstrate the clinical feasibility of converting the predicted doses into deliverable plans.
METHODS AND MATERIALS: Three deep learning models were pretrained on 3232 public plans and fine-tuned on institutional cohorts (256 HN and 72 pancreas patients). The accuracy of the fine-tuning strategy was compared with the baseline trained from scratch using only institutional data. In a prospective setting, the predicted dose was used as the planning goal for fully automated plan generation. Automated plans were benchmarked against clinical plans using Plan Quality Metrics. The deliverability of the fully automated plans was verified by Mobius ion-chamber patient-specific quality assurance (PSQA).
RESULTS: Relative to training from scratch, transfer learning significantly accelerated convergence and minimized prediction error in scenarios with limited site-specific data. For HN cases, fine-tuning yielded a prediction error of 1.76 Gy. Notably, models fine-tuned on just 5% (n = 12) of the dataset achieved accuracy comparable to models trained from scratch using 50% (n = 116) of the training data. In the pancreas cohort, fine-tuning resulted in a mean absolute error of 1.35 Gy, representing a 14.6% reduction compared to the baseline trained solely on institutional data. When used for automated planning, these predicted 3D doses improved planning target volume homogeneity and organs at risk sparing (esophagus and trachea) in HN plans, while pancreas plans aimed to meet clinical goals with reduced dose to the spinal cord and right kidney. All automated plans were confirmed as clinically deliverable via PSQA.
CONCLUSION: Compared with models trained from scratch on institutional data, transfer learning significantly reduced prediction error and improved robustness. The feasibility of converting predicted doses into clinical plans while maintaining plan quality through a fully automated process was demonstrated.
key_points_ko: 췌장암 코호트(72명)에서 전이학습 미세조정을 통해 평균 절대 오차 1.35 Gy를 기록하며 기존 방식 대비 오차를 14.6% 줄였습니다.
자동화된 췌장암 방사선 계획은 치료 목표를 만족하면서 척수와 우측 신장에 조사되는 선량을 낮추는 결과를 보였습니다.
환자별 정도관리(PSQA) 검증 결과, 인공지능이 세운 모든 전자동 치료 계획이 실제 임상 치료에 전달 가능한 수준임을 확인했습니다.
summary_ko: 데이터가 부족한 환경에서 두경부암과 췌장암 환자의 방사선 치료 선량을 정확히 예측하고 치료 계획을 전자동으로 세우는 딥러닝 모델 연구입니다. 공개된 3,232건의 치료 계획으로 사전 학습한 후 두경부암 환자 256명과 췌장암 환자 72명의 데이터로 미세조정을 진행했습니다. 췌장암 코호트에서 기존 대비 선량 예측 오차를 14.6% 줄였으며 척수 및 우측 신장의 피폭을 감소시켰습니다. 생성된 모든 자동화 치료 계획은 실제 임상에서 안전하게 조사 가능한 것으로 확인되었습니다.
title: End-to-end automated radiotherapy planning using transfer learning to overcome data scarcity
